title: 第十七章 山雨欲来
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
任毅正要给这厮一脚，让他知道知道什么是上下尊卑，灵雎醒了。

    凯坐在车上看着和前世记忆完全不一样的巴黎，凯的心中也感慨万千。在凯的印象里，巴黎这座城市可硬气一点不沾边。

    他放松心神，试着感应外界的原力，他眼睛一亮，能感应到，强压兴奋，开始试着慢慢吸取，这次也是用身体各处慢慢吸收原力，但马上他又眉头紧皱，竟然如同淋雨，从身上滑行而过，只停留了一瞬，这是为何？

    闻言，谢瑶光微微颔首却目露警惕地盯着四周，拢在袖里的手已经扣在了九幻黑莲上。

    图图犬对于艾伦平时安排给他的训练早就一清二楚，不用艾伦多说，他就直接来到一个表面早已伤痕累累的沙包面前，然后戴上一对放在沙包架子上的黑色拳套。

    边泽部署了没有出战守城将士全部上防线，同时派出了所有的探子，还犹自不放心，自己也不休息，就在城楼全身甲胄的观望着。

    “那你呢？维克多？成为一个刽子手，就是你想要的选择吗？”凯轻声问道。

    言罢，径直举剑冲向谢瑶光与卓靖。早先前就料到会有此举的卓靖，不慌不迭地拉着谢瑶光避到一侧，继而利落地于唇畔吹出哨声。哨音落下至林间冲出十名黑衣劲装之人，将谢瑶光护在后面。

    向金来伤心的道。他想起了他们一家可谓九死一生。父亲辛辛苦苦十几年基业毁于一旦，举家逃亡，想到这里，悲从中来，眼眶湿润。

    只见这个‘人’就像传说中的马人一样，上半身人身，下半身却是一匹马的样子。手持一把长矛，长矛的顶端却是怪异的闪电状，看起来分外的古怪。

    数百道风刃洗地，所有靠近的生化人在这风刃面前没有任何的抵抗能力，就算长着坚硬的龟甲的忍者神龟也被一分为二，大量飞起的内脏在空中被继续切割。

    “若君……” 他朝大门的方向，虚弱的喊了一声，突然眼前一黑，身子瘫软了下来，昏死过去。
content_en:
Just when Ren Yi was about to give this guy a kick to show him what superiority and inferiority meant, Lingju woke up.

    Kai sat in the car and looked at Paris, which was completely different from what he remembered in his previous life. Kai was filled with emotions. In Kai's impression, Paris is a city that has nothing to do with toughness.

    He relaxed his mind and tried to sense the force of the outside world. His eyes lit up and he could sense it. He suppressed his excitement and began to slowly try to absorb it. This time, he slowly absorbed the force from all parts of his body. But immediately he frowned again. It was like rain, and it slid past his body and only stayed for a moment. Why was this?

    Hearing this, Xie Yaoguang nodded slightly but stared at the surroundings with vigilance. The hands in his sleeves were already clasped on the Nine Fantasy Black Lotus.

    Tutu Dog knew all about the training that Allen usually arranged for him. Without Allen saying anything, he came directly to a sandbag that was already scarred on the surface, and then put on a pair of black gloves placed on the sandbag shelf.

    Bianze deployed all the soldiers who were not in action to defend the city, and also sent out all the spies. He was still uneasy and did not rest himself. He just watched from the tower in full armor.

    "What about you? Victor? Is becoming an executioner the choice you want?" Kai asked softly.

    After saying that, he raised his sword and rushed towards Xie Yaoguang and Zhuo Jing. Zhuo Jing, who had expected this move long ago, calmly pulled Xie Yaoguang to one side, and then whistled neatly on his lips. The whistle sounded and ten men in black clothes rushed out from the forest, guarding Xie Yaoguang behind.

    Xiang Jinlai said sadly. He remembered that their family had a narrow escape from death. My father's hard work for more than ten years was ruined, and his family fled. Thinking of this, I felt sad and my eyes were filled with tears.

    I saw that this 'man' was just like the legendary horse man. His upper body was human, but his lower body was like a horse. He was holding a spear, but the top of the spear was shaped like a weird lightning bolt, which looked extremely weird.

    Hundreds of wind blades washed the ground, and all the approaching biochemicals had no ability to resist the wind blades. Even the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles with hard turtle shells were split into two, and a large number of flying internal organs continued to be cut in the air.

    "Ruojun..." He shouted weakly in the direction of the door. Suddenly his vision went dark, his body collapsed, and he passed out.
